list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM metric ORDER BY 1

list.name: node_id
list.label: Node
list.query: SELECT node_id AS __value, coalesce(long_name, '0x'||to_hex(node_id)) AS __text FROM node_identity WHERE region = '$region' ORDER BY 2

list.name: device_metrics_field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric WHERE packet_type = 'Telemetry' AND metric_name LIKE 'device_metrics.%' AND region = '$region' ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment_metrics_field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric WHERE packet_type = 'Telemetry' AND metric_name LIKE 'environment_metrics.%' AND region = '$region' ORDER BY 1

list.name: air_quality_metrics_field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric WHERE packet_type = 'Telemetry' AND metric_name LIKE 'air_quality_metrics.%' AND region = '$region' ORDER BY 1

list.name: power_metrics_field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric WHERE packet_type = 'Telemetry' AND metric_name LIKE 'power_metrics.%' AND region = '$region' ORDER BY 1

list.name: local_stats_field
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric WHERE packet_type = 'Telemetry' AND metric_name LIKE 'local_stats.%' AND region = '$region' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.time AS "time", coalesce(n.short_name, n.long_name, '0x'||to_hex(m.node_id)) AS metric, m.value_numeric AS value
FROM metric m
LEFT JOIN node_identity n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND m.packet_type = 'Telemetry'
  AND m.metric_name = '$device_metrics_field'
  AND m.value_type = 'numeric'
  AND m.region = '$region'
  AND ($node_id::bigint = -1 OR m.node_id = $node_id::bigint)
ORDER BY m.time

SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_id) node_id, latitude, longitude
FROM metric
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND region = '$region'
ORDER BY node_id, time DESC

FROM node_position_history

ORDER BY time
